name: rulereceipt
description: RuleReceipt — a skill and commands to check what your agent actually did against your CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules. Reads the finished session locally and reports each rule followed, broken (with the quoted line), or needs-judgment.

plugins.name: rulereceipt
plugins.description: rulereceipt skill + /rulereceipt:check, :audit, :health, :why. Runs the rulereceipt CLI locally; no hooks installed, zero network calls, blocks nothing — it reports after the fact.
